intro: Lyria Du Lac is a human warrior trainer stationed in Goldshire within Elwynn Forest. Tucked away just behind the village smithy, she drills novice combatants and guides young warriors as they begin mastering their stances and arms.

p: While Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn bustles with travellers and its blacksmith hammers away at local trade goods, Lyria Du Lac keeps to the yard behind the forge. Experienced in martial discipline, she serves the Alliance by instructing fledgeling warriors fresh from Northshire Abbey. She evaluates their readiness and introduces them to specialized combat techniques, ensuring that those who take up shield and blade for Stormwind can hold their own against the encroaching threats of Elwynn Forest.
